kokod is the koko server, on Linux; koko is the CLI that people and agents run.

Commands:
  kokod run               Run the koko server in the foreground, as its systemd unit and the image do
  kokod install           Install and start the koko server here, as root, or upgrade it, and print what initialising it needs
  kokod uninstall         Stop the koko server here and remove its units, its upgrade helper and kokod, as root; its data, Root Key and system user stay
  kokod upgrade           Upgrade kokod here to the release the koko server asked for, as root, and put the previous one back when the new one does not start; koko-upgrade.service runs it
  kokod version           Print this kokod's build
  kokod help [<command>]  Print this help, or a command's, as <command> --help does

kokod install and kokod uninstall are the machine's part of koko server install
and koko server uninstall, which run them: to install, upgrade or uninstall the
koko server on this machine, run those as root. kokod upgrade is the upgrade
helper, which koko-upgrade.service runs when koko server upgrade or the web UI
asks for an upgrade.
